save themselves or have nobody to whom they may appeal

Yesterday I heard a neighbour speaking about

Siao Lien, whose actual name or nativity is

Fearing that she was still too young to bear

"Mutual insertion" means two persons simultaneously
using their fingers.

"Mutual contact" means two persons, one on top
of the other and rubbing their "precious things" against
each other's.

"Mutual tonguing" means two persons who lick
each other with lip or tongue.

"Mutual insertion" means two persons who take
turns to insert her "screen" into --- of the other. This
cannot be done unless one possesses a long "screen."

The "Crystal" ( 晶秋 ) publishes the following
article on February 16, 1940 :-

Most paintings of the Tang and Sung Dynasties
bear the signatures and remarks of well-known writers
and painters. However, there are generally no such
signatures or remarks on paintings of sexual subjects.
There is an exception in the case of a sexual painting
carrying the remarks of Chang Tsiu ( 法丑 ). The

show a man and a woman embracing each other in the

strongly holding the seat of the woman engaged with
the man, while a second waitress is shown pushing the

girls are shown engaged with one man. There were

Crystal (晶報), a mosquito paper, published on January

A PLEA FOR SUPPRESSION OF ADVERTISEMENTS FOR
APHRODISIACS

During the past few years, large numbers of dealers
in aphrodisiacs have made their appearance in Shanghai, as
witness the amount of advertising matter in local leading
dailies and mosquito papers.

Contending that the publication of advertisements in
the local Press was insufficient to promote the sale of their
drugs, the dealers in question recently distributed through
the post a large quantity of New Year greeting cards which
bear on the reverse side propaganda matter showing the
effectiveness of their aphrodisiacs.

On January 3 I called on one of my friends. The
latter was scolding his younger son of 13 years of age when
I went into the premises. My friend produced a torn greeting
card which bore the following advertising matter:-

"It should be taken prior to going to bed. Half
an hour later, the user who suffers from smallness
may - - - - , thereby making the other party have the
greatest enjoyment and creating a desire for continuation."

On the reverse side is printed the inscription:

"From a German medical doctor - - "

It happened that the boy was playing with the card
when the father came in and noticed it. Under the present
circumstances in Shanghai, a boy of 13 years of age may
already have some knowledge of sex. Furthermore, my friend
has also a daughter of 15 years of age. I hope that both the
Chinese and foreign kind-hearted people in the Foreign
Settlements will make an effort to save youths from being
spoiled by such activities of dealers in aphrodisiacs.

(Headquarters) Office Notes
Date September 25, 1939.

Commissioner of Police.

Re the Petition for the Release of
Suspension of Publication of "Crystal".

In regard to the above, a representation came to my
hand under the name of Secretary Han Moo Pao, publisher's
agent of the Crystal Daily News, and then I investigated
into the affair as follows:-

1. The above paper was established in March 1919 and the
number of its circulation was something arround 1,000.
This paper has taken a comparatively mild attitude as a paper
of this nature since its foundation.

2. On May 3rd, 1939 the paper registered with the S.M.P.
with No. C. 484, after the Proclamation No. 4878 of the
Municipal Council.

3. This paper was suspended for two months on September
2nd, on the gound that its article on rice affair appeared
on August 24th, denounced the S.M.C. based entirely upon
the unfounded fact.

I consider it quite reasonable that the S.M.P. took
the administrative measure against the paper, regarding it
as disturbing the peace and order in the Settlement, however,
I fear that the S.M.P. ordered the two months' period of
suspension of publication could not but be the subject of
a criticism as inflicting too excess a punishment.

1. Generally the period of suspension of the publication
of newspaper does not exceed a couple of days or so, and
even in case the paper committed a very serious offence,
it is, I believe, usually limited within several days.

It is rather a rare case that the suspension of
publication of a paper ordered even in the case that the
authorities may punish its editor or publisher according to the
situation. In the International Settlement several cases
occurred in which the S.M.P. suspended or actually checked
page_data.zh:
（总部）办公室笔记
日期 1939年9月25日。

致警务处处长。

关于《晶报》解除停刊处罚的申请。

关于上述事项，我以《晶报》出版代理人韩慕宝（Han Moo Pao，音译）秘书的名义收到一份陈述，随后我对此事进行了如下调查：-

1. 该报创办于1919年3月，发行量约为1,000份。自创刊以来，该报作为此类性质的报纸，态度相对温和。

2. 1939年5月3日，在工部局第4878号公告之后，该报向上海公共租界工部局警务处注册，注册号为 C. 484。

3. 该报于9月2日被勒令停刊两个月，理由是其在8月24日刊登的关于米荒的文章，完全基于毫无根据的事实谴责工部局。

我认为上海公共租界工部局警务处对该报采取行政措施，视其为扰乱租界和平与秩序，是完全合理的；然而，我担心上海公共租界工部局警务处下令停刊两个月的决定，难免会被批评为处罚过重。

1. 通常报纸停刊期不超过几天左右，即使报纸犯下非常严重的罪行，我相信通常也仅限于数天之内。

即使在当局可根据情况惩罚其编辑或出版人的情况下，下令停刊也是较为罕见的案例。在公共租界，曾发生数起上海公共租界工部局警务处暂停或实际检查

page_data.en:
- 2 -

the publication on the ground that the paper disturbed
the peace and order of the society in relation to the
hostilities. However, despite of the serious situation
the period of such suspension did not exceed any more
than two weeks.
2. Some say it is rather generous a punishment that
the authorities merely ordered the two months' suspension
in spite of the Crystal being essentially to be suspended
its publication because of its serious nature of offence.
However, this is just like a person who was to be punished
with death penalty but was exempted from death and sentenced
to the confinement for 200 years. The latter can be said
an empty theory which disregard the vital capacity of
human being as well as the former does not realize the
faculty of a newspaper.
3. I earnestly hope that the special consideration will
be given for the immediate release of its suspension, for
the publisher's agent expressed deep regret for committing
the said offence and manifested that the paper will strictly
observe the order of the S.M.P. in written form, and now
that a score of days has elapsed since its suspension and
the object of punishment has already perfectly been attained.

Yours faithfully,

Special Deputy Commissioner.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

出版物的事件，理由是这些报纸扰乱了与社会敌对行动相关的社会和平与秩序。然而，尽管局势严重，此类停刊期从未超过两周。
2. 有人说，尽管《晶报》因其罪行性质严重本应被勒令停刊，但当局仅下令停刊两个月，这已是相当宽大的处罚。然而，这就好比一个人本应被判处死刑，但免于一死，却被判处200年监禁。后者可以说是一种无视人类生命活力的空洞理论，正如前者未认识到报纸的生存能力一样。
3. 我恳切希望能给予特别考量，立即解除其停刊处罚，因为出版代理人已对犯下所述罪行表示深切悔恨，并以书面形式表明该报将严格遵守上海公共租界工部局警务处的命令，且自停刊以来已过去数十天，处罚的目的已完全达到。

您忠实的，

特别副总监。

Crystal (晶報), a mosquito paper, published on August 24
the following article written by one Mei Suh (梅瘦):-

How to Deal With Treacherous Rice Hoarding Merchants:
Mr. T.K. Ho Issues a Statement

Yesterday I met a friend named Zia (謝)
who is in the service of the Police Department of the
S.M.C. We talked about the rice situation.
According to Mr. Zia, various high
officials of the Council, after the sudden rise in the
price of rice, called several meetings to discuss the
problem lest it should affect peace and order.
The day before yesterday Mr. T.K. Ho,
Associate Secretary of the Council, issued the following
statement to the middle and junior grade Chinese employees:
"The public hopes that the S.M.C. will purchase, according
to the measures adopted in the winter of 1937, large
quantities of rice from foreign countries for the purpose
of relieving the local food situation and checking the
rise in the price of rice. However, they are ignorant of
the fact that the Council has its own hardships, because
the situation at present is different from that in former
times. Shanghai to-day is not short of rice; the rise
in the price is solely due to hoarding by treacherous
merchants. Such a state of affairs will seriously affect
the livelihood of the people. According to my personal
opinion, the following measures of suppression should be
adopted: officials should first be detailed to conduct
an investigation and when this has been done, merchants
hoarding rice should be assembled and advised to sell
their stocks. If they reject the advice, their shops
or hongs will be closed and they will be prohibited from
undertaking any other business. If this is done, these
merchants will obey the order.
"As to the question of ordering rice by
the Council, it is to be feared that the price will not
be less than $30 a picul in view of the adverse exchange.
So the Council must give careful consideration to the
matter. On the last occasion the S.M.C. had purchased
rice from abroad, the price paid was about the same as
the market price, but later the market price recorded
a big drop due to continued arrival of rice from various
places and nobody wanted to buy rice from the Council
at this high price and even the Chinese employees of the
Council would not buy for the market price was 5 to 6
dollars lower than the price of the Council's rice.
In view of this, the Council sold the rice to its
Chinese employees at a low price and suffered a considerable
loss. For this reason, the Council does not intend to
purchase foreign rice."
Mr. Zia added that according to the latest
information, the price of rice had increased to more
than $35 a picul since August 13. People with small
income and the unemployed are sending the old and weak
members of their families, wives and children to their
native places in the country so as to reduce their
burden.
It is learned that during the past ten days,
more than 800,000 people have returned to their native
places in the country.

《晶报》（Crystal），一份小型报刊，于8月24日刊登了梅瘦撰写的一篇文章：-

如何对付奸诈的囤米商人：
何德奎先生发表声明

昨日我遇到一位在工部局警务处任职的朋友谢（Zia）先生。我们谈到了大米局势。据谢先生称，在大米价格突然上涨后，公董局的各位高官召开了几次会议讨论此问题，以免其影响治安与秩序。前天，公董局副华务秘书何德奎（T.K. Ho）先生向中下级华员发表了如下声明：“公众希望工部局能按照1937年冬季采取的措施，从国外购买大量大米，以缓解本地粮食状况并抑制米价上涨。然而，他们不了解公董局自有其难处，因为目前的形势与以往不同。今日上海并不缺米；价格上涨完全是由于奸商囤积所致。这种状况将严重影响民生。依我个人之见，应采取以下压制措施：首先应派遣官员进行调查，调查完成后，应召集囤米商人，劝告他们出售库存。如果他们拒绝劝告，则关闭其店铺或商号，并禁止其从事任何其他业务。若如此做，这些商人将会服从命令。
“至于公董局订购大米的问题，鉴于汇率不利，恐怕价格不会低于每担30元。因此，公董局必须对此事予以慎重考虑。上次工部局从国外购买大米时，支付的价格与市价大致相同，但后来由于各地大米持续运抵，市价大幅下跌，无人愿意以如此高的价格购买公董局的大米，甚至公董局的华员也不购买，因为市价比公董局大米的价格便宜5到6元。有鉴于此，公董局以低价将大米出售给其华员，遭受了相当大的损失。基于此原因，公董局不打算购买外国大米。”
谢先生补充说，根据最新消息，自8月13日以来，米价已涨至每担35元以上。低收入者和失业者正将家中的老弱成员、妻儿送往乡下老家，以减轻负担。
据悉，在过去十天里，已有超过80万人返回乡下老家。

Subject "Crystal" - Application for Registration

Made by and Forwarded by D. S. McKeown.

Forwarded herewith is an application for registration
with the S.M.C. received from Mr. C.Y. Kwan (关裕宇), editor
of the "Crystal" (晶报), a mosquito daily.

It will be recalled that the "Crystal" was
originally published and edited by the late Yu Ta-yung
(余大雄), a pro-Japanese Chinese journalist, who was murdered
in the New Asia Hotel (新亚酒店) in Hongkew last year.

In 1937 Yu Ta-yung sold his paper to a new concern
formed by Zien Hwa (钱华), another pro-Japanese Chinese
journalist. It suspended publication after the murder of
Zien Hwa on February 7 last.

After purchasing from the widow the shares belonging
to her husband, a new concern known as the Chinese and
American Union Company was formed by Mr. S.T. Chang (蒋旭初),
the Manager of the paper, and Mr. A.L. Teodoro, an American
citizen who is the proprietor of the Teodoro Cigar Manufacturing
Company with an office at Room No.424, House No.131 Museum
Road.

On April 27, Mr. Teodoro, the publisher, was
interviewed at headquarters when a warning was given that
under no circumstances matter liable to give rise to a breach
of the peace and good order should be published in his paper.

In reply, Mr. Teodoro stated that the paper would
feature articles on literature and will have nothing to do with
politics, whether pro-Japanese or pro-Chinese, and that he
would see to it that the advice of the Police was strictly
observed. The publication will be registered as Chinese.
The old certificate (attached)
is returned for cancellation.
D. C. (Special Branch).

由于西区越界筑路地区存在众多赌窟，该地已变成黑色世界。由于许多赌窟受到爱国分子的警告和炸弹袭击，人们现在不敢去那里。因此，国际租界内的海阿莱赌博变得非常兴盛。

..... 黄昏时分，住在厨房楼上房间的一位先生向窗外望去，观察着两姐妹的举动。后者通常在放下绿色纱帘后洗澡。有一天，洗完澡后，她们在床上“嬉戏”，并用甜美的声音交谈。虽然你无法清楚知道她们在谈论什么，但她们的声音和举止足以让你着迷。

page_data.en:

The elder became a widow only about three days after
marriage, while the younger was discarded by her lover.
They felt lonely and were perturbed by thoughts of
love. On the day in question, they had been moved
by the love story of a picture screened in the Lido Theatre
and on their return to home they "played" like husband and
wife. By turn, one of the two sisters played the role
of a husband and the other acted as a wife and simultaneously
they changed their upper and lower positions with each
other. They went crazy and mad, and took no notice
of the gentleman in the opposite house who was setting
his eyes upon them. .........

Translation of extract from article appearing in the 7th
issue of Tao Hua Jih Pao dated Oct. 2, 1940.

When Siao Loh saw Siao Lau Sz coming nearer, he
stretched out one of his hands to hold the waist of Siao Lau
Sz and used the other to get hold of the switch of the electric
light. No sooner had a sound "Poh" been heard than the
light went off.
Siao Lau Sz shouted in the darkness, "Light up, light
up."
Siao Loh laughed, saying in the darkness, "Never mind,
never mind. The light was switched off so that we may have
a dark dance. I won't eat you up. Don't let it worry you."
There were then in this room only Siao Loh and Siao
Lau Sz, the former being a man and the latter being a woman.
Nobody knows what they did in darkness. When the light was
again on, Siao Loh was still seated in his sofa chair, while
some change of the powder on the face of Siao Lau Sz and
cream on her lips was noticeable.

译自1940年10月2日出版的《桃花日报》第7期文章摘录。

当萧洛看到萧劳斯走近时，他伸出一只手搂住萧劳斯的腰，另一只手去按电灯开关。只听见“啪”的一声，灯就灭了。
萧劳斯在黑暗中喊道：“开灯，开灯。”
萧洛在黑暗中笑着说：“没关系，没关系。关灯是为了让我们跳黑灯舞。我不会吃了你。别担心。”
当时房间里只有萧洛和萧劳斯两人，前者是男人，后者是女人。没人知道他们在黑暗中做了什么。当灯再次亮起时，萧洛仍坐在他的沙发椅上，而萧劳斯脸上的粉和唇上的口红可以看出有些变化。

page_data.en:
Tseng Pao dated Sept. 11, 1940:

A certain gentleman is fond of dancing. He is at present employed as a make-up artist with the XX Funeral Parlour. At one time he was crazy over a taxi-dancer and did everything he could to win her favour, but when his money was exhausted, he was discarded by the taxi-dancer. He became angry and severed all connection with her.

One day a female corpse was removed to the funeral parlour. The woman had committed suicide over disappointed love. She was the taxi-dancer with whom he was once fascinated.

On seeing the corpse, the gentleman became very sad. He stripped the body naked and touched it from head to foot over and over again, but when he reached the "X" part, the gentleman suddenly stopped moving his hand, and "in sending the plug" said to himself, "I suffered much, both mentally and financially, for this 'thing' of yours, while you yourself have sacrificed your youth because of this 'thing'."

__________

Tseng Pao dated Sept.12, 1940:

He fell into my arms. He stealthily unbuttoned my clothing and touched and played with a certain part of my body which was then in bud. This did not cease until we both fell asleep.

1940年9月11日《增报》：

某先生喜欢跳舞。他目前在XX殡仪馆担任化妆师。有一段时间，他迷恋上一位伴舞女郎，并竭尽全力博取她的欢心，但当他的钱花光后，便被那位伴舞女郎抛弃了。他变得愤怒，并与她断绝了所有联系。

一天，一具女尸被送到殡仪馆。该女子因失恋而自杀。她就是那位曾让他着迷的伴舞女郎。

看到尸体后，这位先生非常悲伤。他将尸体剥光，从头到脚反复抚摸，但当他的手到达“X”部位时，他突然停住了手，并在“插入插头”时自言自语道：“为了你这个‘东西’，我在精神和金钱上都受了很多苦，而你自己也因为这一‘东西’牺牲了青春。”

__________

1940年9月12日《增报》：

他倒在我的怀里。他偷偷解开我的衣服，抚摸并把玩着我身体当时正处于发育阶段的某个部位。直到我们都睡着为止，这种行为才停止。

Subject (in full) Suspected Indecent Performance at the Shanghai Dance Hall,
Lane 141/10 Canton Road.

Made by Inspt. Varndell. Forwarded by T.S.Blenkinsop C/S.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (DIVISIONS) NOV 7 1941）

Sir,

With reference to the attached report referring
to an advertisement published in the Sin Wan Pao on the
29-10-41 relating to a floor show called "Clam Dance"., I
beg to report that observations were duly kept. Nothing
indecent was seen. The show consisted of one performer
who danced at certain intervals. Each time seen, she was
attired in brassier and short panties, in addition, she
was wearing a flimsy skirt.

However, this dance has now discontinued. The
establishment has been warned, that in future should another
floor show be arranged, they must first submit details to
the Special Branch for approval.

（批：I suppose they have to advertise in this strain to attract their male clients.）

（批：S.G.）
（批：Warned misshaped if similar adverts have been seen）

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant.
R.H. Varndell
Inspector.

Shanghai Daily News (上海日報), a mosquito paper, published
the following article on March 30 :-

"YA YA WU" PERFORMANCE INVADES THE SETTLEMENT

Those who have seen the dances performed
at the Ning King (寧宮), Zing An (靜安), Woo Ping (和平 now
known as Chung Hwa 中華) and the defunct E-Ding (億定) Theatres
will require no enlightenment from us as to the nature of these
dances. Now these performances --- which, for lack of a
suitable name, we call "Ya Ya Wu" (軋軋舞) dances --- have
penetrated deeply to the centre of the Foreign Settlements.
Recently there has sprung up a theatre on
a street where dried longan and sandalwood shops abound. It
is not the Sin Loh King (新樂宮) Theatre at the corner of
Kiukiang and Hoopah Roads nor the Golden Gate (金門) Theatre
which is located on the premises of the Dah Faung (大方) Hotel
on Rue Tourane. The dancing, singing and plays staged at
this theatre belong to the same category as those one sees
in various amusement resorts, but the young girl, who is
barely 15 or 16 years of age and who performs the "Ya Ya Wu"
dance, reveals, through an imitation straw skirt made of gray
coloured cotton yarns, the most mysterious part of the human
body. The eyes of about 80 spectators are glued to this
spot and during this fleeting second there is dead silence
as everybody holds his breath.
In the last act, two women of a type even
lower than prostitutes strip off their clothing in front of
the audience. At first they stand on the stage with their
backs to the audience, later they face the audience with the
front part of their bodies, and finally they flee towards the
back stage. One of the women is as thin as an incense stick,
but the other is stout and as dark as a charcoal basket with
ulcer marks all over her leg.
From enquiries, it is learned that the
women who "make these absolute sacrifices" for the theatre
conductor, are paid only $4 or $5 each a day.

P. T. O.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE APR 1941）

《上海日报》（Shanghai Daily News），一家小型八卦报刊，于3月30日刊登了以下文章：

“轧轧舞”演出侵入租界

那些曾在宁宫（Ning King）、静安（Zing An）、和平（Woo Ping，现称中华 Chung Hwa）以及已停业的亿定（E-Ding）戏院观看过舞蹈表演的人，无需我们要对这些舞蹈的性质多做解释。如今，这些因缺乏合适名称而被我们称为“轧轧舞”（Ya Ya Wu）的表演，已深入公共租界的中心地带。最近，在一条遍布桂圆干和檀香店的街道上，出现了一家戏院。它既不是位于九江路与虎丘路（Hoopah Roads）转角的新乐宫（Sin Loh King）戏院，也不是位于图兰路（Rue Tourane）大方（Dah Faung）旅馆址内的金门（Golden Gate）戏院。该戏院上演的舞蹈、歌唱和剧目属于各类游乐场所常见的类型，但那位年仅十五六岁、表演“轧轧舞”的年轻女孩，透过一条用灰色棉线仿制的草裙，露出了人体最神秘的部位。约80名观众的目光紧紧盯着这一部位，在这短暂的一瞬间，全场屏息，死一般寂静。
在最后一幕中，两名比妓女地位更低的女子当着观众的面脱去衣物。起初她们背对观众站在台上，随后转身面向观众展示身体正面，最后逃向后台。其中一名女子瘦如香烛，另一名则体态丰满，肤色黑如炭篓，腿上布满溃疡疤痕。
经查询得知，这些为戏院班主“做出绝对牺牲”的女子，每人每天仅获酬金4或5元。

请翻页。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1941年4月）

As the interior arrangements of the Carol Night Club located in Love Lane on Bubbling Well Road are mysterious and its location is quiet, lovers regard the club as a suitable place where they can talk about love.
